resources.string: Match the name, password and security type in the car hotspot settings. Changes apply at the next connection.
Manual head unit hotspot (recommended)
Hotspot password
Enter the hotspot SSID.
The SSID must be at most 32 UTF-8 bytes.
The SSID or password contains an invalid character.
The hotspot password must contain 8–63 characters. Leave it empty only for an open hotspot.
Wireless connection
Hotspot mode
Mode and credential changes take effect at the next connection. Your current CarPlay session continues.

Selecting this mode attempts to turn on the head unit hotspot with its saved configuration. Enter the matching SSID and password here. Your iPhone connects to this hotspot. The app does not rename it, change its password, or turn it off.
Hotspot SSID and password
Not configured
Check that the head unit’s hotspot is on and its SSID and password match those saved in Connection settings. On your iPhone, join this hotspot and enable Auto-Join.
Turning on the head unit hotspot…
Head unit hotspot is on. Its saved name and password were kept.
Hotspot control permission is missing. Allow modifying system settings and retry; your firmware may require additional system privileges.
This firmware does not expose an available hotspot start interface. Turn on the hotspot in system settings.
The hotspot could not be confirmed as on. Check the switch in system settings.
Hotspot startup was cancelled.
CarPlay is running. To preserve the connection, the hotspot switch was not changed. Retry after disconnecting.
Allow modifying system settings
